definition.description: Path to an agent definition markdown file with YAML frontmatter.

name.description: Built-in or discovered agent definition name. Also GROK_AGENT and --agent-profile.

system_prompt_label.description: Global system-prompt identity; per-model override wins.

announcements.description: Remote announcement payloads consumed at load. Not a user-authored table.

auth.description: Alias of [grok_com_config]; every grok_com_config. key also works as auth..

auth_provider_command.description: External auth binary; stdout is the token. With endpoints.models_base_url or models_list_url set, that endpoint's list decides which models are offered. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_COMMAND; also valid as grok_com_config.auth_provider_command.

auth_provider_label.description: Login button label for an external auth provider. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_LABEL; also valid as grok_com_config.auth_provider_label.

auth_token_ttl.description: Token TTL in seconds for providers that return a bare token. Also GROK_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL; also valid as grok_com_config.auth_token_ttl.

disable_api_key_auth.description: Refuse API-key auth so only the deployment IdP can log in. Also GROK_DISABLE_API_KEY_AUTH; also valid as grok_com_config.disable_api_key_auth.

force_login_team_uuid.description: Require login to this team UUID, or any of an array; empty array fails closed. Also GROK_FORCE_LOGIN_TEAM_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.force_login_team_uuid.

grok_ws_origin.description: Websocket origin for grok.com. Also GROK_WS_ORIGIN; also valid as grok_com_config.grok_ws_origin.

grok_ws_url.description: Relay websocket URL. Also GROK_WS_URL; also valid as grok_com_config.grok_ws_url.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 provider used when enterprise OIDC is unset; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.

client_id.description: OAuth2 client id. Also GROK_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.client_id.

issuer.description: OAuth2 issuer URL. Also GROK_OAUTH2_ISSUER; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.issuer.

principal_id.description: Required principal id when principal_type is set. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.principal_id.

principal_type.description: Token principal type, such as Team. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_TYPE; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.principal_type.

referrer.description: Referrer for OAuth usage attribution. Also GROK_OAUTH2_REFERRER; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.referrer.

scopes.description: OAuth2 scopes. Also GROK_OAUTH2_SCOPES; also valid as grok_com_config.oauth2.scopes.

oidc.description: Customer OIDC identity-provider settings; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.

audience.description: Optional OIDC audience. Also GROK_OIDC_AUDIENCE; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.audience.

client_id.description: OIDC client id. Also GROK_OIDC_CLIENT_ID; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.client_id.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL. Also GROK_OIDC_ISSUER; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.issuer.

scopes.description: OIDC scopes. Also GROK_OIDC_SCOPES; also valid as grok_com_config.oidc.scopes.

preferred_method.description: Pin automatic auth to one method with no fallthrough; also valid as grok_com_config.preferred_method.

token_header.description: Header name that carries the CLI auth token; default xai-grok-cli; also valid as grok_com_config.token_header.

<name>.description: Named credential helper used by [model.<id>] auth_provider.

campaigns.description: Named campaign patches applied below requirements. The deployment publishes these.

auto_update.description: Check for CLI updates on launch. Also GROK_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER to suppress.

grove.description: Convenience that turns both grok clone and session / -w Grove on when the specific knobs are unset. Also GROK_GROVE. false / copy / off means enable-all is off (fall through); it does not force both surfaces off. [cli] grove_worktree and GROK_WORKTREE_TYPE still win for worktrees; GROK_CLONE still wins for clone. Remote grove_worktree = false still kills worktrees only.

grove_worktree.description: Session / -w Grove vs copy. Default copy. Distinct from creation-mode cli.worktree_type. Also GROK_WORKTREE_TYPE. Layer order: request → env → local → enable-all (GROK_GROVE / [cli] grove) → remote-true; then kill last: remote grove_worktree = false → copy (remote_kill). Missing remote settings are not a kill: local/env/request/enable-all still apply. Does not enable grok clone.

installer.description: Which installer last set up this CLI, used to pick the update path.

maximum_version.description: Highest CLI version that still runs without a hard block. Also GROK_MAXIMUM_VERSION.

minimum_version.description: Lowest CLI version that still runs without a hard block. Also GROK_MINIMUM_VERSION.

npm_registry.description: npm registry used by the auto-updater.

required_maximum_version.description: Hard maximum CLI version. Also GROK_REQUIRED_MAXIMUM_VERSION.

required_minimum_version.description: Hard minimum CLI version. Also GROK_REQUIRED_MINIMUM_VERSION.

session_picker_grouped.description: Group sessions by repo in the picker and CLI listings.

session_registry.description: Participate in the cross-process session registry.

use_leader.description: Use the leader process for config reload and MCP watches.

worktree_type.description: Creation-mode when set to linked, standalone, or git. The spellings grove, grove-fuse, grove-nfs, nfs, and copy also feed the session / -w Grove gate (same as cli.grove_worktree); they are not creation-mode values.

mcps.description: Scan Claude MCP config. Also GROK_CLAUDE_MCPS_ENABLED.

skills.description: Scan Codex skills directories when present.

agents.description: Scan agent definitions from Cursor compat sources. Also GROK_CURSOR_AGENTS_ENABLED.

skills.description: Scan Cursor skills directories. Also GROK_CURSOR_SKILLS_ENABLED.

default_auto_mode.description: Start sessions in auto permission mode when no per-session override is set.

crash_handler.description: Write a panic report under $GROK_HOME/crash/. Also GROK_CRASH_HANDLER.

disable_web_search.description: Drop the web_search tool for this process. Also --disable-web-search.

disabled_mcp_servers.description: MCP server names to skip without deleting their [mcp_servers] blocks.

disabled_mcp_tools.description: Per-server MCP tool deny lists keyed by server name.

enabled.description: Resample confident tool-call loops; set false to disable.

deployment_key.description: Management key for enterprise deployments. Also GROK_DEPLOYMENT_KEY.

feedback_base_url.description: Where feedback submissions go. Also GROK_FEEDBACK_BASE_URL.

managed_config_url.description: Override managed config endpoint. Also GROK_MANAGED_CONFIG_URL.

models_base_url.description: Custom inference base URL. With auth_provider_command set, {models_base_url}/models decides which models are offered. Also GROK_MODELS_BASE_URL.

models_list_url.description: Override model-list URL. With auth_provider_command set, this list decides which models are offered. Also GROK_MODELS_LIST_URL. Alias models_endpoint.

trace_upload_bucket.description: Direct gs:// or s3:// bucket for traces; bypasses the proxy. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_BUCKET.

trace_upload_credentials.description: Inline GCS service-account JSON or AWS credentials for that bucket; wins over trace_upload_credentials_file and has no environment variable.

trace_upload_credentials_file.description: Path to a GCS service-account JSON or AWS credentials file for that bucket. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_CREDENTIALS_FILE.

trace_upload_endpoint_url.description: Custom S3-compatible endpoint for s3:// bucket uploads. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT_URL.

trace_upload_region.description: AWS region for s3:// bucket uploads; default us-east-1. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_REGION.

trace_upload_url.description: Proxy destination for traces when no direct bucket is set. Also GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_URL.

xai_api_base_url.description: Public xAI API base. Also GROK_XAI_API_BASE_URL.

fail_closed.description: Refuse to start when signed requirements or version_overrides cannot be applied; default false.

active_agent_messages.description: Enable or disable active_agent_messages. Default false. Also GROK_ACTIVE_AGENT_MESSAGES.

ask_user_question.description: Enable or disable ask_user_question. Default true. Also GROK_ASK_USER_QUESTION.

auto_wake.description: Enable or disable auto_wake. Default true. Also GROK_AUTO_WAKE.

backend_tools.description: Enable or disable backend_tools. Default true. Also GROK_BACKEND_SEARCH.

campaigns.description: Enable remote campaign patches. GROK_CAMPAIGNS=0 still disables even when requirements set this true.

cancel_rewind.description: Enable or disable cancel_rewind. Default true. Also GROK_CANCEL_REWIND.

codebase_indexing.description: Codebase graph indexing; true indexes git repos, or pass include/exclude globs.

compaction_detail.description: Verbatim detail level for segments compaction. Also GROK_COMPACTION_DETAIL.

compaction_verbatim_input.description: Enable or disable compaction_verbatim_input. Default true. Also GROK_COMPACTION_VERBATIM_INPUT.

dock.description: Enable or disable dock. Default false. Also GROK_DOCK.

feedback.description: Enable or disable feedback. Default true. Also GROK_FEEDBACK_ENABLED.

feedback_trace_card.description: Show a trace-upload consent question after /feedback. Default false. Also GROK_FEEDBACK_TRACE_CARD.

file_acceleration.description: Hand local sessions' file systems to a file accelerator when the build installs one. Default false. Also GROK_FILE_ACCELERATION.

image_edit.description: Pin image_edit availability. Requirements only; a user-file entry is unrecognized and unset leaves the remotely configured default.

image_gen_model_override.description: Imagine model id for image_gen. Empty defers to the remotely configured default.

lsp_tools.description: Enable or disable lsp_tools. Default false. Also GROK_LSP_TOOLS.

managed_config.description: Fetch managed_config.toml and requirements.toml from the deployment.

mcp_auto_restart.description: Auto-restart stdio MCP servers after transport failure. Also GROK_MCP_AUTO_RESTART.

mcp_liveness_watchers.description: Poll MCP transports and push server_status updates. Emergency kill switch when false.

mcp_push_server_status.description: Pager subscribes to MCP server_status push. Process env GROK_MCP_PUSH_SERVER_STATUS wins at launch.

mcp_recursive_config_watch.description: Watch <cwd>/ and <cwd>/.grok/ for project MCP config edits. Name is a misnomer; watches are non-recursive.

non_git_warning.description: Show a blocking warning when Grok starts outside a Git repository.

remember_mode.description: Remember the last permission mode across sessions. Read from user config.toml only.

remote_fetch.description: Pin remote model-catalog and asset fetch. Managed wins over the user file when both set.

session_recap.description: Enable or disable session_recap. Default true. Also GROK_SESSION_RECAP.

session_search.description: Enable or disable session_search. Default true. Also GROK_SESSION_SEARCH.

subagent_model_inheritance.description: Hide the subagent model argument when every model you can pick is an xAI model, so subagents inherit the parent's model. Default false. Also GROK_SUBAGENT_MODEL_INHERITANCE. Read when a session starts; changing it requires a restart.

subagent_worktree_snapshot.description: Enable or disable subagent_worktree_snapshot. Default false. Also GROK_SUBAGENT_WORKTREE_SNAPSHOT.

support_permission.description: Allow the agent to ask permission for tool executions.

telemetry.description: Product telemetry mode. Enterprise default is off.

terminal_theme.description: Reveal the terminal-native terminal color theme during its rollout. Default false. Also GROK_TERMINAL_THEME.

title_refresh.description: Early-session auto-title refresh. Pin this in requirements to beat GROK_TITLE_REFRESH.

turn_summary.description: Enable or disable turn_summary. Default true. Also GROK_TURN_SUMMARY.

two_pass_compaction.description: Enable or disable two_pass_compaction. Default true. Also GROK_TWO_PASS_COMPACTION.

voice_mode.description: Enable or disable voice_mode. Default true. Also GROK_VOICE_MODE.

web_fetch.description: Enable or disable web_fetch. Default false. Also GROK_WEB_FETCH.

write_file.description: Enable or disable write_file. Default true. Also GROK_WRITE_FILE.

zdr_access_enabled.description: Advertise ZDR-incompatible tools when the team is on Zero Data Retention. Also GROK_ZDR_ACCESS_ENABLED.

command.description: Shell command that prints name and email JSON for feedback submissions.

email.description: Sources for the feedback author email (git_email or a literal).

name.description: Sources for the feedback author name (os_user or a literal).

routes.description: Route override passed unparsed to the installed file accelerator; empty is unset. Also GROK_FILE_ACCELERATION_ROUTES.

grok_com_config.description: Grok.com websocket and OAuth/OIDC settings. [auth] is an alias.

auth_provider_command.description: External auth binary; stdout is the token. With endpoints.models_base_url or models_list_url set, that endpoint's list decides which models are offered. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_COMMAND.

auth_provider_label.description: Login button label for an external auth provider. Also GROK_AUTH_PROVIDER_LABEL.

auth_token_ttl.description: Token TTL in seconds for providers that return a bare token. Also GROK_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL.

disable_api_key_auth.description: Refuse API-key auth so only the deployment IdP can log in. Also GROK_DISABLE_API_KEY_AUTH.

force_login_team_uuid.description: Require login to this team UUID, or any of an array; empty array fails closed. Also GROK_FORCE_LOGIN_TEAM_ID.

grok_ws_origin.description: Websocket origin for grok.com. Also GROK_WS_ORIGIN.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 provider used when enterprise OIDC is unset.

principal_id.description: Required principal id when principal_type is set. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_ID.

principal_type.description: Token principal type, such as Team. Also GROK_OAUTH2_PRINCIPAL_TYPE.

referrer.description: Referrer for OAuth usage attribution. Also GROK_OAUTH2_REFERRER.

preferred_method.description: Pin automatic auth to one method with no fallthrough.

token_header.description: Header name that carries the CLI auth token; default xai-grok-cli.

disable_workspace_teleport.description: Kill switch for per-turn workspace snapshots.

wait_for_uploads.description: Wait for turn-end trace uploads before returning the prompt response. Off by default; one-shot headless runs instead drain pending turn-end uploads at exit within a mandatory minimum budget (about 150s: the parse window plus one upload attempt) that upload_flush_timeout_secs, when larger, extends.

<event>.description: Matcher groups for a lifecycle event such as PreToolUse or Stop. See Hooks.

command.description: Command to run for this hook. $VAR is not expanded at load.

type.description: Hook handler type. Command hooks are supported.

matcher.description: Tool-name matcher for this hook group.

delay.description: Model calls to wait after the long call before the reminder. Default 1, clamped to 0–10. Also delay in the GROK_LONG_REASONING_REMINDER JSON object.

enabled.description: Inject a mid-turn reminder to reason briefly after a model call with long hidden reasoning. Default false. Also GROK_LONG_REASONING_REMINDER (a bool word, or a JSON object in this table's shape).

tokens.description: Reasoning tokens in one model call that count as long. Default 1000, clamped to 100–200000. Also tokens in the GROK_LONG_REASONING_REMINDER JSON object.

enabled.description: Fetch managed MCP configs at startup. Also GROK_MANAGED_MCPS_ENABLED.

gateway_tools_enabled.description: Expose managed MCP gateway tools. Also GROK_MANAGED_MCP_GATEWAY_TOOLS_ENABLED.

require_sha.description: Tighten-only: remote plugin installs and updates must pin a full commit sha. Also GROK_MARKETPLACE_REQUIRE_SHA. Neither this key nor the env var can turn the gate back off.

max_output_bytes.description: Cap MCP tool output size in bytes. Project files may set this.

args.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] args on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

bearer_token_env_var.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] bearer_token_env_var on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

bearer_token_file.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] bearer_token_file on an HTTP MCP server: absolute or ~/ path to a bearer token, re-read on every request.

command.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] command on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

cwd.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] cwd on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

enabled.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] enabled on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

env.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] env on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

expose_image_base64.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] expose_image_base64 on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

headers.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] headers on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

oauth.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] oauth on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

oauth_client_id.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] oauth_client_id on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

oauth_client_secret_env_var.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] oauth_client_secret_env_var on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

oauth_scopes.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] oauth_scopes on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

setup.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] setup on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

startup_timeout_sec.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] startup_timeout_sec on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

tool_timeout_sec.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] tool_timeout_sec on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

tool_timeouts.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] tool_timeouts on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

type.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] type on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

url.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] url on a stdio or HTTP MCP server.

enabled.description: Legacy memory switch. Also GROK_MEMORY; superseded when the v2 gate is enabled.

archived_retention_days.description: Retains archived memory-v2 observation files for this many days. Default: 30.

automatic_dream_enabled.description: Enables event-driven memory-v2 Dream. Default: true.

batch_dream_enabled.description: Runs active memory-v2 Dream as batch Dream, which folds notes into topics in batches with the full topic catalog; a local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_enabled, then defaults to false.

batch_dream_max_batch_note_bytes.description: Caps note bytes in one batch Dream batch, default 98304, clamped to 16384–262144. A local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_max_batch_note_bytes.

batch_dream_max_calls_per_batch.description: Caps model calls per batch Dream batch, default 6, clamped to 2–16. A local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_max_calls_per_batch.

batch_dream_max_run_secs.description: Caps one batch Dream run in seconds, default 1800, clamped to 60–3600; unfinished notes stay in the inbox. A local value wins over remote memory_v2.batch_dream_max_run_secs.

capture_enabled.description: Enables memory-v2 extraction and observation capture. Default: true.

capture_status_enabled.description: Shows memory-v2 capture lifecycle messages in the UI for debugging. Successful captures are expandable and include generated content plus links to committed observation files. Telemetry and debug logs are always recorded. Default: false.

compact_index_enabled.description: Injects a titles-only memory index into the system prompt (no topic descriptions, no pending observations) so more topics fit the 8 KiB budget; titled entries are ordered by how often the agent has read each topic, and the on-disk MEMORY.md is rendered the same way. A local value wins over the remote memory_v2.compact_index_enabled. Default: false.

enabled.description: Primary memory-v2 switch. When true, v2 takes precedence over legacy memory.enabled. When false or absent, legacy enablement is resolved normally. Default: false.

file_writes_enabled.description: Enables all memory-v2 file mutation; false fails closed before scaffold creation. Default: true.

job_retention_days.description: Retains terminal memory-v2 capture-job metadata for this many days. Default: 14.

manual_dream_enabled.description: Enables explicitly requested memory-v2 Dream. Default: true.

rollout.description: Advanced staged-rollout control for new v2 sessions. Default: "active" after enabling v2. Most users should leave this unset.

<id>.description: Per-model override or BYOK definition. Prefer env_key over inline api_key.

agent_type.description: Agent definition type associated with this model.

api_base_url.description: Alternate API base used with XAI_API_KEY resolution.

api_key.description: Inline API key. Prefer env_key. Not a secret to put in a shared repo.

auth_provider.description: Name of a [auth_provider.<name>] helper that mints this model's bearer token.

compaction_at_tokens.description: Token threshold that triggers compaction for this model.

compactions_remaining.description: How compaction leftover context is sent. Alias send_compactions_remaining.

context_window.description: Context window tokens; drives auto-compact timing.

description.description: Optional description shown in the picker.

env_http_headers.description: HTTP headers populated from environment variables when set.

env_key.description: Environment variable name(s) holding the provider API key.

hidden.description: Hide this model from the picker. Still usable via -m.

inference_idle_timeout_secs.description: Idle timeout for streaming inference on this model.

max_request_bytes.description: Provider request-body cap that inline images are evicted to stay under. Unset inherits the [model_providers.<id>] value, then the api_backend default: 30 MB for messages, 50 MiB otherwise.

model.description: Model id sent to the API.

model_family.description: Family id used for compaction and capability grouping.

model_provider.description: Named [model_providers.<name>] provider id for this model.

mtls_cert_dir.description: Directory containing the model endpoint's mTLS identity as client.crt and client.key, or tls.crt and tls.key; configuration is rejected unless the same model has one HTTPS base_url and no api_base_url, and requests do not follow redirects.

name.description: Label shown in the model picker.

notice.description: Message shown above the prompt while this model is selected, cleared for this model by a blank text.

query_params.description: Extra query parameters on this model's requests.

rate_limit_retry_threshold.description: Total-attempt ceiling for rate-limited requests, capped by the resolved max_retries; when configured, it disables the separate subagent 429 wait loop.

reasoning_efforts.description: Allowed reasoning-effort values for this model. When omitted, the menu comes from the endpoint's /v1/models row (reasoning_efforts, or capabilities.reasoning_effort when that is absent).

reasoning_summary.description: Responses API reasoning.summary for this model; default concise. none omits the field for endpoints that reject it (e.g. AWS Bedrock Mantle).

show_model_fingerprint.description: Show the provider model fingerprint in the UI when present.

subagent_rate_limit_max_attempts.description: Maximum subagent 429 wait-loop attempts when rate_limit_retry_threshold is unset; default 8, maximum 32, and 0 disables the wait loop.

supported_in_api.description: Whether this catalog entry is offered as a public API model.

supports_backend_search.description: Whether the endpoint supports Grok-hosted server-side search tools.

supports_reasoning_effort.description: Deprecated; prefer reasoning_efforts. An explicit false keeps the model out of any menu it would otherwise inherit from the endpoint or from a same-model catalog entry.

use_concise.description: Use the concise tool-description pack for this model.

agent_type.description: Fallback agent_type for models without a per-model override.

allowed_models.description: Glob allowlist for the model picker, default, and -m, ignored outside requirements.toml when auth_provider_command and a custom models endpoint are set. Empty means no restriction.

default.description: Model used for new sessions. Also GROK_DEFAULT_MODEL, --model, -m.

default_reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort for the default model when the model supports it.

disabled_models.description: Remove these model IDs from the catalog. Wins over hidden_models.

extra_headers.description: Request headers applied to every model; per-model keys win.

hidden_models.description: Hide these model IDs from the picker; -m can still select them.

image_description.description: Vision model used to transcribe user-supplied images.

inference_idle_timeout_secs.description: Global idle timeout for streaming inference when a model leaves it unset.

max_completion_tokens.description: Global max completion tokens default when a model leaves it unset.

max_retries.description: Global inference retry default when a model leaves it unset.

prompt_suggestion.description: Model pin for next-prompt ghost text. Unset falls through remote, then the session model.

rate_limit_retry_threshold.description: Global total-attempt ceiling for rate-limited requests when a model leaves it unset, capped by the resolved max_retries; when configured, it disables the separate subagent 429 wait loop.

session_summary.description: Model used for session titles and summaries.

stream_tool_calls.description: Global tool-call streaming request shape; some BYOK endpoints need false.

subagent_rate_limit_max_attempts.description: Global default for subagent 429 wait-loop attempts when rate_limit_retry_threshold is unset; default 8, maximum 32, and 0 disables the wait loop.

temperature.description: Global sampling temperature default when a model leaves it unset.

top_p.description: Global top_p default when a model leaves it unset.

web_search.description: Model used by the client web_search tool. Also GROK_WEB_SEARCH_MODEL.

path_not_found_hints.description: Enrich path-not-found errors with CWD reminders and similar-name suggestions.

extra_rule_dirs.description: More rule directories (absolute or ~/…; each contains *.md), loaded after the home rules.

extra_skill_dirs.description: Records /import-claude skill directories that skill injection ignores in favor of [skills] paths.

allow.description: Compact allow rules such as Bash(git *). Deny beats ask beats allow. Project files may set this.

ask.description: Compact ask rules. Project files may set this.

deny.description: Compact deny rules. Project files may set this.

rules.description: Verbose action/tool/pattern object rules. Project files may set this.

disabled.description: Plugin IDs to discover but not load. Project files may set this.

enabled.description: Plugin IDs to enable; needed for project plugins that default off.

paths.description: Additional plugin directories. Project files may set this when the folder is trusted.

privacy_banner_acked.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the local privacy banner was dismissed. The pager reads user config.toml only.

max_output_tokens.description: Visible-output tokens for the suggestion call; clamped to 16–256, default 64, with a separate reserve for reasoning. Remote-overridable.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the suggestion call; default and none disable reasoning, while other values use a supported model effort. Remote-overridable.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the suggestion call (default 0.2). Remote-overridable.

auto_allow_bash.description: Skip bash permission prompts when a sandbox profile is active. Also GROK_SANDBOX_AUTO_ALLOW_BASH.

profile.description: Filesystem sandbox profile. Also --sandbox and GROK_SANDBOX.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description: Auto-compact when context usage reaches this percent (0–100).

exclude.description: Env names to drop from bash. Overlay-allowlisted.

ignore_default_excludes.description: Skip the built-in env denylist. Overlay-allowlisted.

include_only.description: If set, bash inherits only these env names. Overlay-allowlisted.

inherit.description: Which parent env names bash inherits. Overlay-allowlisted; cannot inject values.

set.description: Inject env values into bash. Not overlay-allowlisted.

disabled.description: Skill names to discover but not activate.

cleanup_ttl_days.description: Days a session may stay idle before its folder is deleted; media and terminal logs older than this are pruned from live sessions; unset or 0 disables cleanup.

enabled.description: Subagent / task tool master switch, default true even when other subagents.* keys are set. Also GROK_SUBAGENTS or --no-subagents.

limit_behavior.description: What to do when the concurrent subagent cap is hit.

<name>.description: Enable or disable an individual subagent type. Omitted agents default on.

otel_certificate.description: PEM path of extra CA certs for the collector. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CERTIFICATE. CA pin does not strip endpoints.

otel_client_certificate.description: PEM path of the mTLS client certificate. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE. Pin strips credential copies, developer endpoints, and unlisted file siblings.

otel_client_key.description: PEM path of the mTLS client key. Tokens never live in this file. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CLIENT_KEY.

otel_enabled.description: External OTEL master switch. Also GROK_EXTERNAL_OTEL.

otel_endpoint.description: External OTLP base endpoint. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Pin strips developer env and unlisted user/managed file siblings except listed.

otel_log_assistant_responses.description: Content gate for grok_code.assistant_response text. Unset follows otel_log_user_prompts unless a sibling gate is pinned in requirements. Env-only OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS=1 must set this to 0 (or pin it false) for a prompts-only stream. Also OTEL_LOG_ASSISTANT_RESPONSES.

otel_log_tool_content.description: Body gate for tool_input, tool_output, full_command, and error_message. Independent of details; default off. CONTENT-only loses verbatim MCP names and paths. Also OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT.

otel_log_tool_details.description: Metadata gate for tool-arg preview, paths, and verbatim names. Recommended on for SIEM join. Also OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS. Does not include full bodies.

otel_log_user_prompts.description: Content gate for prompt text on grok_code.user_prompt. Also OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS. Pinning any content gate without listing a sibling defaults the omitted sibling off.

otel_logs_certificate.description: Logs-signal CA PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_CERTIFICATE.

otel_logs_client_certificate.description: Logs-signal mTLS client cert PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE.

otel_logs_client_key.description: Logs-signal mTLS client key PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_LOGS_CLIENT_KEY.

otel_logs_exporter.description: External OTEL logs exporter. Also OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER.

otel_metric_export_interval.description: Metric export interval in milliseconds. Also OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL.

otel_metrics_certificate.description: Metrics-signal CA PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_CERTIFICATE.

otel_metrics_client_certificate.description: Metrics-signal mTLS client cert PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE.

otel_metrics_client_key.description: Metrics-signal mTLS client key PEM path. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_CLIENT_KEY.

otel_metrics_exporter.description: External OTEL metrics exporter. Also OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER.

otel_metrics_include_session_id.description: Attach session.id to metrics. Also OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID.

otel_protocol.description: External OTLP transport. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL. Pin strips per-signal protocol env and unlisted file siblings except listed.

otel_timeout.description: Export timeout in milliseconds. Also OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT.

trace_upload.description: Upload session traces. Requirements pin beats user config.

disable_zdr_incompatible_tools.description: Restrict tools that need xAI-hosted output under ZDR. Also GROK_DISABLE_ZDR_INCOMPATIBLE_TOOLS.

max_parallel_image_gen_calls.description: Cap parallel image_gen/image_edit calls in one model step. Also GROK_MAX_PARALLEL_IMAGE_GEN_CALLS.

max_parallel_video_gen_calls.description: Cap parallel video_gen calls in one model step. Also GROK_MAX_PARALLEL_VIDEO_GEN_CALLS.

respect_gitignore.description: When true, search and read tools skip gitignored files. Also GROK_RESPECT_GITIGNORE.

zdr_video_output_s3.description: Team S3 bucket for ZDR video output. See ZDR Video Storage.

auto_background_on_timeout.description: Background the command when the foreground timeout fires.

login_shell_capture.description: Capture the user's login shell environment for bash. Overlay-allowlisted.

output_byte_limit.description: Max captured bash output in bytes.

timeout_secs.description: Foreground bash command timeout in seconds.

proxy_endpoint.description: Egress proxy URL for web_fetch. Also GROK_WEB_FETCH_PROXY.

allowed_domains.description: Domain allowlist for client web_search. Overlay-allowlisted.

excluded_domains.description: Domain denylist for client web_search. Overlay-allowlisted.

auto_dark_theme.description: Theme when theme = auto and the OS is dark.

auto_light_theme.description: Theme when theme = auto and the OS is light.

cancel_subagents_on_turn_cancel.description: What to do with running subagents when cancelling a parent turn.

collapsed_edit_blocks.description: Show edits as one-line +N/-M summaries. Also GROK_COLLAPSED_EDIT_BLOCKS.

combine_queued_prompts.description: Merge consecutive plain follow-ups into one turn.

image_input.description: Clipboard image paste tip when the model accepts images.

plan_mode.description: Suggest plan mode (Shift+Tab) for planning-style prompts.

send_now.description: After queuing a mid-turn follow-up, Enter on an empty prompt sends now.

ssh_wrap.description: Recommend grok wrap when SSH lacks a clipboard sink.

undo.description: Ctrl+Z restores a wiped prompt draft tip.

word_select.description: After double-click with fold/nav selection, point at Word select in settings.

cursor_blink.description: Force blinking (true) or steady (false) block cursor. Unset inherits the terminal.

dashboard_preview.description: The dashboard preview and reply panel appear by default (Appearance in /settings).

default_selected_permission.description: Preselected approval row on the first prompt of a session. Also GROK_DEFAULT_SELECTED_PERMISSION.

disable_bypass_permissions_mode.description: Lock always-approve off. The lock is enforced only from a requirements layer; true in user or managed files is ignored.

auto_cadence_enabled.description: Match stream/scroll cadence to display refresh rate. Also GROK_DISPLAY_REFRESH_AUTO_CADENCE.

fork_secondary_model.description: Model for the secondary agent when forking. Defaults to the main default model.

group_tool_verbs.description: Fold consecutive read/search/list tool rows. Also GROK_GROUP_TOOL_VERBS.

hunk_tracker_mode.description: File-change hunk tracking. Also GROK_HUNK_TRACKER and --hunk-tracker-mode.

invert_scroll.description: Reverse vertical scroll direction. Also GROK_INVERT_SCROLL.

keep_text_selection.description: In-app selection: brief flash, hold, or double-click word select.

max_thoughts_width.description: Column width for the thoughts panel (40–500).

mouse_reporting_toggle.description: Ctrl+R in scrollback toggles terminal mouse capture. Also GROK_MOUSE_REPORTING_TOGGLE.

page_flip_on_send.description: Snap the sent prompt to the top of the viewport.

permission_mode.description: Default tool-permission behavior. Enterprise locks use requirements.toml.

prompt_suggestions.description: Next-prompt ghost text after each turn. Also GROK_PROMPT_SUGGESTIONS; a remote kill-switch can disable it fleet-wide.

remember_tool_approvals.description: Show per-tool Always allow options. Also GROK_REMEMBER_TOOL_APPROVALS.

render_mermaid.description: How mermaid fences render: clickable open row or raw source.

screen_mode.description: Default render mode for plain grok. Restart required.

scroll_lines.description: Lines per scroll tick (1–10). Also GROK_SCROLL_LINES.

scroll_speed.description: Mouse/trackpad scroll speed multiplier (1–100). Also GROK_SCROLL_SPEED.

show_thinking_blocks.description: Show thinking/reasoning blocks while streaming. Also GROK_SHOW_THINKING_BLOCKS.

show_timeline.description: Per-turn tick rail instead of the scrollbar.

show_timestamps.description: Clock time next to messages. Also /timestamps.

simple_mode.description: Readline prompt editing when true; experimental vim prompt keys when false.

command.description: Script for a command status line. Campaigns strip this path; a requirements layer still merges it.

type.description: Optional status-line row above the shortcuts bar. Off by default. See the status-line user guide.

theme.description: Color theme name, or auto/system to follow the OS. Also /theme and GROK_THEME.

vim_mode.description: Vim keys in the scrollback, not the prompt. Also /vim-mode.

voice_keybind_enabled.description: Enable Ctrl+Space / F8 for voice dictation. /voice still works when false.

voice_stt_language.description: Speech-to-text language code or auto. Overrides [voice].language for the session.

yolo.description: Always-approve tool calls. Requirements can pin false and block --yolo.

version_overrides.description: Per-CLI-version config patches applied before merge. See [[version_overrides]].

api_base.description: HTTPS API root for speech-to-text. Unset inherits [endpoints].xai_api_base_url.

language.description: Preferred STT language catalog code or auto.
